verdict.rationale: cubic documents kicking off agent work from GitHub. Commenting `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR` starts a review, PR comments can trigger reviews and fixes, and "Fix with cubic" generates a fix and pushes it to the PR branch. Only one of the four named surfaces is covered: Linear appears only as linked-issue context for requirement analysis, not as a trigger, and GitLab and Slack are not mentioned. Missing for 10: GitLab triggering, Linear-initiated agent tasks, Slack-initiated agent tasks, independent corroboration of the GitHub triggers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Post this comment on GitHub to start a review
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
